# Public validation samples

These are validation inputs, not training data. Files are unmodified samples
from scikit-image commit `c1af2bf80d2c8845bbbf06222f87e8b58a8e5c1e`
(v0.19.3), `skimage/data/`. Checksums and exact URLs are in `sources.json`.

| File | Credit | Permission documented by scikit-image |
| --- | --- | --- |
| astronaut.png | NASA, Eileen Collins portrait | Public domain |
| coffee.png | Rachel Michetti; courtesy Pikolo Espresso Bar | CC0 |
| chelsea.png | Stefan van der Walt | CC0 |
| rocket.jpg | SpaceX, Falcon 9 / DSCOVR | Public domain |

Source and permission statements: [official sample documentation](https://scikit-image.org/docs/0.25.x/api/skimage.data.html),
entries `astronaut`, `coffee`, `chelsea`, and `rocket`.
CC0 legal text: <https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode>.
These pictures are not relicensed under the repository's code license.
Contact sheets in `docs/images/` are crops/resizes and color transformations
of these same permitted images; credit and status remain as above.
